scope: CPU design calculation only; no model outcomes inspected
source_count: Frozen validation-summary manifest: 1800 cases, 174 class-28-positive cases
method: Known exact one-sided zero-failure binomial bound: 1 - delta^(1/n)
limits: Zero failures is hypothetical, not an observed outcome.
87/87 split and equal 29-case strata are design examples, not actual selected splits.
Independent positive cases, fixed policy, no outcome-based selection, and no shift assumed.
Multiple lesions or patches from one patient do not increase independent case count.
All 174 cannot serve as independent final validation if used to tune the policy.
Nonzero failures worsen bounds; selecting policies on validation requires correction or another split.
This is not a conformal expected-risk guarantee or a clinical safety result.
Do not access the protected 901-case test evaluation to augment this research cohort.
